newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Virgin says unworried by BA bid for Air Liberte.
newsitem.headline: Virgin says unworried by BA bid for Air Liberte.

text.p: Richard Branson's Virgin Express said on Friday it was not alarmed by reports that rival British Airways (BA) was set to scoop up ailing French domestic carrier Air Liberte.

"I was told...that there is a 30- to 40-day period during which BA has to negotiate the final arrangements with employees and creditors and that would mean that nothing would seem to be firmly resolved until the middle of December," Virgin Express' chief financial officer Jim Swigart told Reuters.
A French commercial court decision on Tuesday that Air Liberte would not be liquidated appeared to clear the way for BA, in partnership with Banque Rivaud, to acquire the struggling airline.

"BA got in early on this...we're still evaluating the situation which is fairly complicated because (Air Liberte) did have substantial problems. We do have an interest in France. We still feel that very much and still feel that Air Liberte is interesting," Swigart said.
BA has said it and Banque Rivaud would give Air Liberte a 630 million French franc ($123.3 million) capital injection. BA
